item.description:
Spring has sprung! Let’s dance! Showy Dance Melbourne & Neruda Brunswick joined forces to bring a night for Bachata & Salsa class + a Social dance night! Every Thursday from 7 pm. 7 pm: Bachata class. 8 pm: Salsa class. 9 pm: Social night. After the 2 classes finished, we will continue the night with Social dance. Neruda Brunswick is a Latino American restaurant located in Brunswick. Address: 66 Breese St, Brunswick. Both of our classes will be Open level. item.title: Salsa Thursdays at Time Out Market — Thu Sep 24, 7:00 PM — Time Out Market New York
item.description:
Join us for one of NYC’s best free salsa nights and turn your Thursday into a dance-floor celebration.
Get your salsa on every Thursday night at Time Out Market New York! Head up to the fifth floor for an electrifying evening of rhythm, movement, and Latin vibes. Whether you’re a total beginner or a seasoned dancer, this is your weekly excuse to move, sweat, and smile. Starting at 7:30 PM, renowned instructor Marlene Veras will guide you through the steps, breaking down the fundamentals so you feel confident on the dance floor. The night is powered by infectious beats from DJ Ray Suave, with live percussion by Jessica La Timbalera, setting the stage for a high-energy salsa experience. After the lesson, the floor opens up for a full-on salsa dance party until 10 PM. Bring a partner or come solo—everyone’s welcome.

item.title: La Société d'histoire de Toronto: HISTORITOUR - The Junction, Partie 1 — Sun Sep 27, 1:30 PM
item.description:
À la croisée des voies ferrées La naissance de The Junction 1ère partie Départ : À l’angle sud-ouest des rues Keele & Dundas West, (servi par les autobus de la rue Keele #89 et #41 et/ou le bus de la rue Dundas ouest #40. Arrivée : Même endroit Guides : Wafa Smiai – Rolande Smith
Il y a 130 ans, The Junction n’était pas un simple quartier de Toronto, mais une municipalité indépendante : West Toronto Junction. Venez découvrir le patrimoine bâti de ce carrefour symbolique, dont les rues ont été tracées selon la logique de trois grandes lignes de chemin de fer se rejoignant à la fin du XIXème siècle. Ce croisement a donné naissance à l’un des secteurs les plus riches en histoire de l’ouest de la ville.

item.title: Tanglefoot Reunion — Sat Oct 3, 8:00 PM — Acoustic Harvest
item.description: The Songs, The Stories, The Spirit of Canada For three decades, Tanglefoot carried the spirit of Canada across stages in North America, the United Kingdom, and Europe with powerful harmonies, quick wit, rich storytelling, and songs rooted in Canadian history. Now this legendary Canadian folk ensemble returns for a special reunion concert, bringing their unmistakable energy, warmth, and humour back to the stage. This new chapter reunites Canadian Folk Music Award winners Steve Ritchie, Al Parrish, Sandra Swannell Young, and Rob Ritchie, joined by Rob’s son, singer and multi-instrumentalist Josh Ritchie, stepping into the place once held by the late Terry Young. It is both a celebration of legacy and a fresh passing of the torch. Audiences can expect fan favourites, hidden gems, stories, laughter, and the kind of heartfelt music that turns a concert into a shared memory.
